title: THUNDERFALL
title_zh: 雷霆战机 · 天穹远征
description: 手机与电脑可玩的原创纵向弹幕射击游戏：三种战机、五大空域、激光与漂移弹、四色武器掉落、关间三选一强化，完整战役至少十分钟有效战斗。
model_attribution: User-declared model and effort in the creation conversation; not independently verified runtime telemetry.
workflow: Iterative implementation with collaborating assistant agents for procedural graphics, campaign design, engine tests, and review; not a one-shot benchmark.
requires: Modern browser with Canvas 2D and JavaScript modules

validation.note: Engine time simulation and autopilot runs do not constitute a ten-minute human browser playthrough or a real-phone performance test.
